## Summary

Describe the outcome and why the change is needed.

## Risk and compatibility

List security boundaries, public API or report changes, false-positive tradeoffs,
and supported platforms affected.

## Verification

- [ ] Added or updated regression tests for behavior changes
- [ ] Added realistic benign coverage for detector changes
- [ ] Ran the relevant unit tests and full suite
- [ ] Ran lint, type, and security checks
- [ ] Updated docs, schema, changelog, and corpus when applicable
- [ ] Used only harmless generated fixtures with recorded origin and license
- [ ] Confirmed no credentials, private data, or unsafe payloads are included
